اقتحمتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَحَمْتُمْ (iqtaḥamtum) /iq.ta.ħam.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اُقْتُحِمْتُمْ (uqtuḥimtum) /uq.tu.ħim.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
